_comment: Waivers for the native-vs-wasm corpus compare (corpus-compare.py corpus-native.json corpus-node.json --exact-svg). The two builds share sve::loadScore and every writer, and all structural fields (pages, measures, positions, midiBytes, metadata) match on all 569 scores. What remains is libm-level float noise: x86-64/glibc (native) and wasm/musl (emscripten) round transcendental functions differently in the last ulp, and slur/tie/ornament layout amplifies that into coordinate differences of 0.02-1.3 engraving units (0.4 um - 0.03 mm at DPI 1200), which the SVG number formatting then turns into a different byte count. Verified per score by diffing the actual SVGs: only curve control points and micro y-offsets move; element structure and order are identical. Toolchains: emsdk 4.0.7 vs g++-10; a toolchain bump that makes any of these equal trips the stale-waiver guard, which is the reminder to drop the entry.
